nbb01ce0898.headline: A $540 Million Gap Raises New Questions About Tajikistan’s Rogun Dam
nbb01ce0898.summary: An independent audit found major accounting gaps, ongoing losses and lender concerns at Tajikistan's flagship Rogun Dam. The findings cast doubt on the project's financial viability.
nbb01ce0898.why: Large hydropower projects are typically financed by state and multilateral lenders, and cost overruns or losses raise questions about debt sustainability and energy supply.

nf589323dee.headline: Thai central bank to expand authority to scrutinise online gold trading
nf589323dee.summary: The Bank of Thailand will expand its authority to scrutinise online gold trading, blaming gold traders for driving up the baht.
nf589323dee.why: The Bank of Thailand manages monetary policy and currency stability. Gold trading flows can affect the baht, and regulators monitor them for market integrity.

n06fd3dab53.headline: Janus Henderson announces exclusive distribution arrangement with HSBC
n06fd3dab53.summary: Janus Henderson has announced an exclusive distribution arrangement with HSBC to launch an innovative thematic global equity fund.
n06fd3dab53.why: Janus Henderson is a global asset manager, and distribution partnerships with major banks help it reach investors. HSBC is one of the largest international banks.

n3117ccc70a.headline: Where home prices could take off or crash land in 2026
n3117ccc70a.summary: A worsening outlook for interest rates is expected to dampen Australia's property market in 2026, though some records may still be set. The outlook varies across locations.
n3117ccc70a.why: Housing is a major part of Australian household wealth and bank lending, so interest rate expectations strongly influence property prices and credit.

n1e42995339.headline: Fast-track change of use for thousands of properties: Offices and shops turn into… homes with a tax bonus
n1e42995339.summary: Greece is fast-tracking change of use for thousands of properties, allowing offices and shops to be converted into homes with a tax bonus. The measure is reported by sofokleous10.gr.
n1e42995339.why: Conversions of commercial property to housing change local property supply and can affect the valuation and rental income of commercial real estate.

n0d55372c5f.headline: Tech, Tariffs and US Jobs Data
n0d55372c5f.summary: Ahead of the first US nonfarm payrolls release of the year, markets priced roughly a 40% chance of a March Fed rate cut, down from nearer 50% earlier in the week. The 2-year yield hovers near 3.50%, while the 10-year yield keeps rising.
n0d55372c5f.why: Nonfarm payrolls is the key US labour-market indicator and strongly shapes Federal Reserve rate expectations, which drive Treasury yields and equity valuations worldwide.
n0d55372c5f.why_moved: Rate-cut expectations have eased ahead of the jobs report, while the 10-year yield keeps climbing as investors assess US military ambitions and their budget implications.

na0f8604eec.headline: IATA notes 5.5% increase in global air cargo demand in Q4-2025
na0f8604eec.summary: Air cargo demand, measured in cargo tonne-kilometres, rose 5.5% in the fourth quarter of 2025 compared with November 2024 levels, according to IATA. The figures come from the global airline trade body's latest report.
na0f8604eec.why: The International Air Transport Association tracks global airline traffic, and air cargo volumes are an indicator of trade flows and demand for freight carriers.

n184b18f098.headline: US and Venezuela take initial steps toward restoring relations after Maduro's ouster
n184b18f098.summary: A Trump administration delegation arrived in Venezuela to assess reopening the US Embassy in Caracas, as the two countries explore restoring diplomatic relations after Maduro's ouster.
n184b18f098.why: Venezuela holds some of the world's largest oil reserves, so changes in its relations with the US can influence sanctions policy and the country's future oil output.

nae60de7f54.headline: EU ambassadors back Mercosur trade deal, EU sources say
nae60de7f54.summary: EU ambassadors have backed the Mercosur trade agreement, according to EU sources. The deal is set to be the largest trade accord the EU has concluded.
nae60de7f54.why: The EU-Mercosur agreement would link the European Union with Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay, affecting tariffs and trade flows in agriculture, autos and other sectors.

nb3f2cdd9d9.headline: Markets Today: Chinese Inflation Edges Higher, Gold Steady with NFP & Supreme Court Decision Now in Focus
nb3f2cdd9d9.summary: Chinese inflation rose slightly, while gold held steady ahead of the US nonfarm payrolls report. Investors are also watching a Supreme Court decision.
nb3f2cdd9d9.why: Chinese consumer price data shape expectations for Beijing's policy easing and global commodity demand. US payrolls data influence Federal Reserve rate expectations.

n4fe84b1ea6.headline: FinancialContent - Rivian Shares Stumble as Massive Suspension Recall Collides with Insider Selling Jitters
n4fe84b1ea6.summary: Rivian shares stumbled as a large suspension recall coincided with concerns over insider selling. The article gives no further figures on the recall's scope.
n4fe84b1ea6.why: Rivian Automotive is a US electric vehicle maker, so recalls and insider share sales affect investor confidence in its vehicles and stock.
n4fe84b1ea6.why_moved: Shares fell as a large suspension recall coincided with worries about insider selling, according to the report.

nd294310126.headline: SEALSQ and Kaynes SemiCon Reach Final Agreement to Develop a Sovereign Indian Post-Quantum Semiconductor Joint Venture in Alignment with MeitY
nd294310126.summary: SEALSQ and Kaynes SemiCon reached a final agreement to develop a sovereign Indian post-quantum semiconductor joint venture, aligned with India's Ministry of Electronics and IT.
nd294310126.why: SEALSQ is a Nasdaq-listed semiconductor and security company, and joint ventures in chips are part of efforts to build domestic semiconductor capacity.

n80e6191e4a.headline: India to focus on skilled jobs, employment quality to achieve inclusive growth: EAC-PM chief S Mahendra Dev
n80e6191e4a.summary: India is shifting focus toward skilled employment and better job quality, with manufacturing seen as key to labour-intensive jobs. The target growth rate is 7.7% for 2022-23 to 2025-26.
n80e6191e4a.why: The Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister advises the Indian government on economic policy, including employment and growth strategy.

n0f110d30c1.headline: Goyal holds talks in Brussels on key issues in India-EU free trade pact
n0f110d30c1.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal held high-level talks with EU Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic in Brussels on efforts to secure a mutually beneficial India-EU free trade agreement.
n0f110d30c1.why: A free trade agreement between India and the European Union would reduce tariffs on a large volume of bilateral trade between two major economies.

n77fbbae630.headline: War Secretary Pete Hegseth visits Long Beach-based Rocket Lab as part of his ‘Arsenal of Freedom Tour’
n77fbbae630.summary: US War Secretary Pete Hegseth visited Rocket Lab in Long Beach as part of his Arsenal of Freedom Tour promoting manufacturing and defense sectors.
n77fbbae630.why: Rocket Lab builds launch vehicles and space systems, and government defense contracts are important to its business.

n8fd67f9f4a.headline: Geopolitics Will Destroy Euro
n8fd67f9f4a.summary: The US dollar advanced after jobless claims rose less than expected, productivity hit a two-year high and the trade deficit narrowed to its lowest since 2009.
n8fd67f9f4a.why: US data on jobs, productivity and trade shape Federal Reserve expectations and currency moves against the euro and other currencies.

n2e1cfd464e.headline: US-China Relations Take a Hit After Venezuela Raid, PMIs Recover, CNY Strengthening Continues
n2e1cfd464e.summary: A commentary says the US capture of Maduro adds a new front in US-China rivalry. It also notes that PMIs recovered and the yuan continued to strengthen.
n2e1cfd464e.why: US-China relations shape trade flows, tariffs and capital allocation across global markets, and the yuan is China's main currency.

ne3b90bec3b.headline: Kia axes petrol-powered family favourites
ne3b90bec3b.summary: Kia has axed several petrol-powered family models in Australia as the country's emissions regulations tighten further, according to a regional news report.
ne3b90bec3b.why: Kia is a South Korean carmaker whose Australian line-up is shaped by national vehicle emissions standards and fuel efficiency rules.

n6e296e40d7.headline: Why failed airtime top-ups in Nigeria will now be refunded in 30 seconds
n6e296e40d7.summary: A framework agreed by two Nigerian regulators and industry stakeholders will refund failed airtime top-ups within 30 seconds, TechCabal reports.
n6e296e40d7.why: Telecom operators in Nigeria are regulated by the Nigerian Communications Commission, and consumer refund rules affect operator revenue and customer trust.

nd6a4685a11.headline: USD/JPY Flirts With Breakout Ahead of Crucial NFP Release
nd6a4685a11.summary: The US dollar stayed above 155.50 and rose against the Japanese yen, settling above 156.00 ahead of the crucial US nonfarm payrolls report.
nd6a4685a11.why: The dollar-yen pair reflects the interest-rate gap between the US and Japan and is closely watched for signals on Bank of Japan intervention risk.

n678dcc7840.headline: EFL says proposed tiered tariff will protect 97% of customers
n678dcc7840.summary: Energy Fiji Limited said its proposed tiered tariff structure is designed to protect vulnerable households and small businesses. It says 97 percent of customers would be protected.
n678dcc7840.why: Energy Fiji is the country's electricity utility, and tariff changes affect household budgets, business costs and regulated utility revenues.

n58bc783f09.headline: Mega miner merger would knock BHP off world No.1 perch
n58bc783f09.summary: One of Australia's biggest commodity companies is considering a $300 billion takeover pitch to form the world's largest mining group. The deal would knock BHP off the top spot.
n58bc783f09.why: BHP is one of the world's largest diversified miners, producing iron ore, copper and potash. Large mining mergers affect commodity supply and sector valuations.
n58bc783f09.why_moved: A proposed takeover pitch worth $300 billion would create the world's largest mining company, reshaping the sector's competitive order.

n4c4ca601e7.headline: EU states back record South America trade accord after 25 years
n4c4ca601e7.summary: EU member states gave the go-ahead for the bloc to sign its largest free trade accord with the South American group Mercosur. Talks began more than 25 years ago.
n4c4ca601e7.why: The EU-Mercosur deal would open trade between Europe and South America's largest bloc, affecting tariffs on agriculture, autos and other goods.

n5c75c8f2e5.headline: Ringgit ends lower ahead of US jobs data, tariff ruling
n5c75c8f2e5.summary: The ringgit closed lower ahead of US jobs data and a US Supreme Court ruling on tariffs. An analyst said a decision to strike down the tariffs would ease inflation pressures.
n5c75c8f2e5.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves reflect regional capital flows and expectations for US interest rates and trade policy.

nb8b4dc9009.headline: India-US trade deal stalled after Modi did not call Trump, says Lutnick
nb8b4dc9009.summary: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi did not call President Donald Trump to finalise the trade deal.
nb8b4dc9009.why: Trade agreements between the US and India affect tariffs and market access for major exporters in both economies.

na0a03e2614.headline: US December Jobs Report in Focus
na0a03e2614.summary: The December US jobs report is due, with forecasts of about 80,000 new jobs and an unemployment rate of 4.5%. Michigan's first consumer sentiment survey of the year also comes out.
na0a03e2614.why: The US jobs report is a key gauge of labour-market health and shapes expectations for Federal Reserve interest-rate policy.

n9eddb41e91.headline: Dollar Leads into NFP as USD/JPY Nears Breakout
n9eddb41e91.summary: The dollar is trading broadly higher in Asian trade and is the week's strongest performer ahead of the December US non-farm payrolls report. USD/JPY is nearing levels that would confirm an upside break.
n9eddb41e91.why: The US non-farm payrolls report is a key measure of American employment, and it influences expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate policy and currency moves.

na37143812f.headline: Euro zone economy caps resilient 2025 with retail and industry boosts
na37143812f.summary: Euro zone retail sales rose more than expected in November, and German industry continued to expand. The data suggest the currency bloc ended a turbulent 2025 on a resilient note.
na37143812f.why: Euro zone retail sales and industrial output are key gauges of growth in the currency bloc, which affects European central bank policy and the euro.

nf7811077d1.headline: African Union, China Agree to Explore Full Potential for Practical Cooperation
nf7811077d1.summary: The African Union and China have agreed to explore the full potential for practical cooperation. The stated aim is to deliver tangible benefits to the peoples of Africa and China.
nf7811077d1.why: China is one of Africa's largest trade and investment partners, so cooperation agreements can shape infrastructure financing and trade flows across the continent.

n44788ec7df.headline: L&K Biomed Ltd. announced that it expects to receive KRW 32 billion in funding from Korea Investment & Securities Co., Ltd., BNK Securities Co.,Ltd., LS SECURITIES Co., Ltd. and other investors
n44788ec7df.summary: L&K Biomed expects to receive KRW 32 billion in gross proceeds from a private placement of series 12 convertible bonds, with Korea Investment & Securities, BNK Securities and LS Securities among investors.
n44788ec7df.why: Convertible bond placements raise capital for listed companies and can later dilute shareholders if the bonds convert into shares.

n26d3e33462.headline: Iran protests get angrier: Government buildings set on fire as uprising enters 12th day — watch
n26d3e33462.summary: Nationwide uprising against Iran's government entered its 12th day on Thursday, with protesters setting government buildings on fire, according to The Times of India.
n26d3e33462.why: Sustained unrest in Iran, a major oil producer, can affect regional stability and energy supply expectations.

naa1655fd36.headline: AUD/USD Under Bearish Pressure
naa1655fd36.summary: The Australian dollar fell below the 0.6680 level, with the decline from Wednesday's high exceeding 1.1%, according to ActionForex chart analysis.
naa1655fd36.why: The Australian dollar is a major currency tied to commodity exports and Chinese demand, so its moves affect trade-exposed markets.

n628622d43b.headline: Bursa ends higher, KLCI hits 6-year high
n628622d43b.summary: Bursa Malaysia closed higher, with the FBM KLCI reaching a six-year high. An analyst said the index remains in a healthy uptrend across short- to long-term timeframes.
n628622d43b.why: The FBM KLCI is the benchmark index of Bursa Malaysia, the stock exchange of Malaysia. It tracks the country's largest listed companies.

impacts.name: FBM KLCI
impacts.why: The index closed higher and reached a six-year high.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n117ccb4d8b.headline: NYMEX Overview :  Petroleum Prices Rise, Putting Them On Track for Weekly Gain -- OPIS
n117ccb4d8b.summary: Crude oil and refined product futures were rising for a second day on Friday morning, putting contracts on track for a weekly gain. Prices were supported by ongoing protests in Iran.
n117ccb4d8b.why: NYMEX, part of CME Group, is the main US venue for crude oil and refined fuel futures, which set benchmark energy prices.
n117ccb4d8b.why_moved: Prices were supported by ongoing protests in Iran, which raise concerns about supply from a major oil producer.

n8818ac2ecf.headline: China CPI surprises to upside at 0.8%, but full-year picture weak
n8818ac2ecf.summary: China's consumer inflation rose to 0.8% year on year in December, above expectations of 0.6% and a 34-month high. The increase was driven mainly by food prices, including a surge in fresh vegetables.
n8818ac2ecf.why: Consumer price inflation is a key gauge of demand and deflation risk in the world's second-largest economy, shaping Chinese policy expectations.

ned76b5ff92.headline: A one-two payrolls, tariff sucker punch?
ned76b5ff92.summary: Investors are holding their nerve ahead of a US jobs report that is likely to show a sluggish but resilient labour market, with tariffs also in focus.
ned76b5ff92.why: The US nonfarm payrolls report is a key indicator of labour market health and influences expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate policy.

n8e1336a219.headline: French opposition parties seek to topple government over Mercosur
n8e1336a219.summary: French opposition parties are seeking to topple the government over the Mercosur trade deal. The government is also struggling to pass a late 2026 budget through parliament.
n8e1336a219.why: Mercosur is the South American trade bloc whose trade pact with the EU affects French agriculture and political stability in Paris.

nd0fc400a6c.headline: USD/CAD Bulls Gear Down Near 1.3900
nd0fc400a6c.summary: USD/CAD reached a one-month high of 1.3887 before retracing half of its November–December decline. The US dollar strengthened as traders cut risk-sensitive currency exposure.
nd0fc400a6c.why: The Canadian dollar, or loonie, is closely tied to oil prices and risk sentiment, and USD/CAD is among the most traded currency pairs.

impacts.name: USD/CAD
impacts.why: The pair rose to a one-month high as the US dollar strengthened.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n4a44f3920c.headline: MARC Ratings forecasts Malaysia's economy to expand 4.3% in 2026
n4a44f3920c.summary: MARC Ratings forecasts Malaysia's economy will expand 4.3% in 2026, supported by domestic demand and investment. Demand for electrical products and data centre infrastructure is a driver.
n4a44f3920c.why: GDP growth forecasts from rating agencies inform investor views on Malaysia's economic outlook and its sovereign credit profile.

n56a46fc3fb.headline: Vietnam shrugs off Trump tariffs as US exports surge
n56a46fc3fb.summary: Official figures show Vietnam's US exports rose 28% despite tariffs. The surge pushed its trade surplus to US$134 billion last year.
n56a46fc3fb.why: Vietnam is a major manufacturing exporter to the United States, so its trade balance is sensitive to US tariff policy.

nb41d6a720c.headline: LCCI, UBL join hands to promote digital payments
nb41d6a720c.summary: The Lahore Chamber of Commerce and Industry and United Bank Limited have signed an MoU to promote digital payments. The agreement aims at safe, fast and efficient transactions for LCCI members.
nb41d6a720c.why: United Bank Limited is a major Pakistani commercial bank, and digital payment adoption shapes how businesses settle transactions in the economy.

n833d5cdad2.headline: SOE Net Losses Surge by Over 300% Despite Rs. 12 Trillion Revenue
n833d5cdad2.summary: Pakistan's state-owned enterprises posted losses of more than 300% in FY2024-25, compared with a net loss of Rs30.6 billion in FY24, despite Rs12 trillion in revenue.
n833d5cdad2.why: State-owned enterprises are large government-controlled companies in energy, transport and utilities, and their losses add to fiscal pressure on the government.

n3d250b8524.headline: Wind farm poised to become Vancouver Island’s biggest power source, empower First Nation
n3d250b8524.summary: The $600 million, 197 MW Wei Wai Kum energy project near Campbell River is expected to come online by 2031. It would make the wind farm the largest power source on Vancouver Island and empower a First Nation.
n3d250b8524.why: Large renewable energy projects add generation capacity and create long-term investment and ownership opportunities for Indigenous communities. Their economics depend on grid demand, financing and offtake contracts.

nbaae7d79f8.headline: UK Moves To Return $9.5m Stolen Funds To Nigeria
nbaae7d79f8.summary: The United Kingdom has finalized arrangements to return $9.5 million in stolen funds to the Nigerian government.
nbaae7d79f8.why: Recovering stolen assets supports Nigeria's efforts to improve governance and economic stability by reclaiming public funds.
